data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m). The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 296.933m. The syndicate reports an aggregate net reserve release of GBP 12m in 2020 (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement calculated from the published gross claims development triangle indicates a small gross release of approximately GBP 3.048m (about -1.03% of opening gross reserves), largely driven by favourable development in Property and Credit & Political Risk, partially offset by deterioration in Tech Liability. The syndicate also completed a third-party RITC for 2017 and prior which affected the presentation of older years.
raw_causal_phrases: a reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability.
our reserves proved more than adequate producing a net reserve release in 2020.
data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a NET prior-year reserve release of GBP 12m but does not disclose a gross PYD figure. A gross prior-year movement was estimated (-GBP 3.048m) using the published gross claims development triangle (comparison of 2018 column current estimate vs prior diagonal). The triangle is limited (columns for 2018-2020 only) and the syndicate completed a RITC transfer of 2017 & prior which affects older-year comparability. LOB mapping for 'PCR' and 'Tech Liability' to standard Lloyd's categories is approximate; amounts by LOB for reserve movements are not quantified in the report, so LOB movement amounts are null.
